title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1238: The reliable little brother (1)

section.p: The battle raged on.
Great Han King had betrayed humanity and attempted to return. Great Zhou King and Junior Zhou King were doing everything they could to intercept him.
While they were fighting, yet another phenomenon spread across the Allheaven Battlefield. This was the third dead Invincible of the day.
A miserable and indignant howl resounded everywhere.
“NOO!”
Human Realm.
The immortal king had just been smashed apart by Zhu Tiandao with a pagoda. He was filled with indignance as he died.
Why?
Where were his tri-life bodies?

He was supposed to rejoin his three bodies and become the strongest person present in the Human Realm. Even without that, he could still contend against Zhu Tiandao as long as his future body was free of any backlash.
But instead, his two bodies had returned dead, inflicting a massive backlash on him, and allowing Zhu Tiandao to kill him without much effort.
He couldn’t accept this.
As an Invincible, how could he accept a death like this?
This was not supposed to happen!
He had too many unrealized ambitions. He had too many things left to do. He had to stay alive! He couldn’t accept this!
He felt incredibly sullen.
He could not accept dying to Zhu Tiandao.
The Immortal Realm trembled while crimson clouds appeared in the sky across the Allheaven Battlefield. Everyone was shocked. Yet another Invincible had perished.
The third dead Invincible of the day.
First, it was Nether River King. Next, Fiery Sea King followed. And now, it was Immortal King Qimu’s turn to die.
All three had perished in the Human Realm.

It occurred to some that the Human Realm was actually far more treacherous to these Invincibles than the Allheaven Battlefield. After all, over a hundred Invincibles were in battle elsewhere, but not one of them had perished thus far. Then again, almost none of them were fighting with their lives on the line.
Meanwhile, those in the Human Realm were fighting desperately with their lives on the line. And that desperation had produced three dead Invincibles.
Nanyuan.
Everyone was stunned.
Holy shit! Was Zhu Tiandao so strong?
He had killed an immortal king!
Meanwhile, Zhu Tiandao looked sullen as he grumbled inwardly. Stop looking at him. Why were they looking at him? The immortal king had been so weakened anyone could have done the same.
Why the fuck was everyone looking at him?
Whatever. He did not forget the most important task in a battle: looting the corpse.
This was an incredible win.

The dead immortal king only left one carrier treasure behind since the other had been destroyed. However, the corpse was still relatively intact. The corpse of an Invincible was exceedingly rare. It was very rare for an Invincible to die with an intact body.
Zhu Tiandao felt like an Invincible corpse had simply dropped into his lap.
He blanked out as this story felt so familiar.
Where had he heard about this before?
Right, his old man.
Many years ago, while fighting in the Allheaven Battlefield, an intact Invincible corpse of a divine had also dropped into his lap out of nowhere.
And the same had happened to him today. How odd.
The other humans were also looking at him with stupefaction.
Even Tan Dang and Mohe, who were both busy summoning their bodies over, were staring with stupefaction. They were reminded that after summoning their bodies over, their deaths would be final.

Their determination wavered if they wondered if they should really proceed. Their bodies were near, but they started to hesitate. It was still somewhat fine to lose only one of their bodies. But losing all their bodies like that immortal king would truly kill them.

The Yellow Department head was still being stopped from summoning his bodies over. The rest of the humans would be no match to them when they were done summoning their bodies and assembling their main bodies.
But what was up with Zhu Tiandao?
He was the second individual to slay an Invincible today.
Everyone was shocked by Zhu Tiandao’s apparent prowess.
This included Su Yu.
Wow. Old Zhu was actually strong enough to slay an Invincible!
He had been hiding his strength way too well before this!

Had he pretended to be weak to lure the tri-life bodies of the immortal over before killing the immortal for real? What a great plan! The experts had been too busy to notice the condition of the immortal king’s two bodies when they arrived while the weaklings had been unable to see anything.
Thus, everyone assumed that Zhu Tiandao had killed an Invincible at his full power with a single hit.
Nobody was prepared for that.
Everyone would be a lot less shocked if it was First Profound or the Yellow Department head who had performed such a feat.
But…Zhu Tiandao? Wasn’t he a tad bit too strong?
He had killed an immortal king like he was squashing a bug.
While everyone was still shocked, Mohe and Tian Dang found their bodies arriving before they could stop the process.
It was too late for them to regret this.
With a roar, they fused their bodies as their auras surged. First Profound and the Yellow Department head were sent flying while coughing blood by the eruption of auras.
The two had completed the assembly of their main bodies.
Zhu Tianfang shouted, “Little Brother, stop one of them! I’ll handle Tian Dang with First Profound!”

Zhu Tiandao’s expression turned ashen. His elder brother was sending him on a suicidal mission! Yes! A suicidal mission! Nobody knew better than him how he had killed the immortal king earlier. And now, he was expected to handle an Invincible with all three bodies fused all by himself?
Nonsense!
His elder brother was totally trying to kill him!
Were they still family?
He clenched his teeth and cursed inwardly, as he moved forth with great determination before asking nonchalantly, “Mohe, let’s have some fun together, shall we?”
It was time to put his acting skills to use.
Instead of using his fists, he preferred using his mouth.
That was his only choice.
Two Invincibles had finished assembling their main bodies. What else could he do?

Meanwhile, Mohe had a solemn expression on his face. Faced with someone capable of killing an Invincible, he was extremely wary. This was the third human who had showcased the ability to kill Invincibles without being an Invincible in recent history. First, it was Ye Batian. Then, came Wan Tiansheng. And Zhu Tiandao was the third.
Divine King Tian Dang was relieved to see that he wasn’t dealing with Zhu Tiandao.
He would much rather face Zhu Tianfang and First Profound than Zhu Tiandao. He sent a voice transmission to Mohe, “Just keep him busy. We wait for Great Han King…”
Mohe cursed inwardly.
Why wasn’t Tian Dang doing this himself?
Why must it fall on him to do this?

He replied through voice transmission, “Even with Great Han King’s return, he will only deal with the multiple character faction. His betrayal is toward that faction, not humanity as a whole. We need more people to enter the Human Realm as well to keep everyone else busy. I’ll do my best to keep Zhu Tiandao busy without resorting to a fight to the death…”
“Sure.”
The two Invincibles reached a decision.
Both cursed inwardly.
The Human Realm was too abnormal.

Zhu Tiandao looked perfectly normal. No, he looked decently strong. But dealing with a regular tri-life body of an Invincible should be all he could do. But instead, he had exceeded all expectations and slain the Invincible.
Suppressing, defeating, and killing couldn’t be more different than each other.
The ability to kill an Invincible signified a strength far beyond the level of regular Invincibles.
These humans were too terrifying.

As Devil King Mohe consoled himself that he would be fine, he entered an alternate dimension with Zhu Tiandao. He was in no rush to start the battle. Rather, he looked at Zhu Tiandao who was in the middle of forcefully capturing a past body and said, “You want to affirm your dao? It won’t be so easy. Zhu Tiandao, we’re only here for the multiple character faction and the Culture Tomb. This has nothing to do with Great Ming King and the Zhu Family. Why must you involve yourself in this mess?”
Huh?
Zhu Tiandao was slightly stunned. But soon, it dawned on him that his opponent was also wary of him.

Right, he was an existence capable of slaying Invincibles! He might be scared of this Invincible, but this Invincible was scared of him as well! After all, this Invincible was here in his complete form. If he died here, he would die for real. Who would be willing to die after reaching such a height in life?
In short, both were wary of the other.

This knowledge greatly consoled Zhu Tiandao’s heart. He smiled and said, “It’s not in our habit to meddle in other’s business. But this is the Human Realm. Since we’re already involved, we can’t stop halfway. Mohe, you’re not a blood fire devil. What’s the point of fighting me to the death? I don’t want to die, and I believe you’re not very interested in dying as well.

“Of course, there is no guarantee that I’ll be able to kill you. But who’s to say that I can’t? I’ll affirm my dao and you’ll watch. This is only the beginning. Why fight so hard at the very start only to end up as a free firework for the Myriad Realms like the other two.”
Devil King Lade frowned. Was this guy really doing this?
Would he be in even more danger upon the completion of this guy’s dao affirmation?
No, he couldn’t allow this. But that would involve fighting. And fighting was very dangerous as well. What now?

Devil King Mohe was anxious. Meanwhile, Divine King Tian Dang was impatiently entering a different alternate dimension with First Profound and Zhu Tianfang. Yes, Nan Wujiang and Zhu Tianfang were very strong. But Divine King Tian Dang had also grown much stronger after assembling his main body.
Not far away, Lan Tian and Lade were still engaged in a bitter battle.

Only three myriad race Invincibles were left in the Human Realm. While two of them had resumed their fight against humanity, one was busy talking to Zhu Tiandao. Neither of the two seemed eager to fight each other.
